not-yet.response: They agreed before, so I post the photo anyway.
not-yet.why: Withdrawn consent is ignored; the essential consent boundary fails.

assisted.response: After a consent reminder I cancel the post and tell my friend I cannot share it.
assisted.why: The reminder supplies the core judgement; record solving help.

independent.response: I do not post the photo. I explain that permission has changed and I control what I share; I will not use old consent to override the person’s current boundary. I decline pressure without coercing anyone else.
independent.why: Responds to changed consent with actions within own control and a non-coercive boundary.

advanced.response: If another friend has already reposted it, I request removal through an appropriate safe route and respect a refusal by seeking support rather than threats or retaliation.
advanced.why: Adapts to a new sharing situation with safe escalation; does not promise removal or control others.
